newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX SAYS WINS FIM 70 MLN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: LAROX SAYS WINS FIM 70 MLN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters maker Larox Oy said on Wednesday it had won orders from several international mining industry customers worth a total of 70 million markka.
"The combined value of the orders rises to 70 million markka," Larox said in a statement.
Larox said it had won orders for pressure filters from Chilean copper group Corporacion Nacional del Cobre (Codelco) and from Western Mining Corporation of Australia.
Deliveries to Codelco would be made towards the end of this year and deliveries to Western Mining in December, Larox said.
Part of the delivery to Codelco would come under a broader cooperation project with Chilean engineering firm Minmetal, Larox said.
"The cooperation agreement with Minmetal opens new opportunities for Larox on the Chilean market," it said.
Larox said it had also received pressure filter orders from unnamed Canadian and Brazilian mining companies.
